The modified-unitarity law is assumed in the carrier; no density operator or quantum-state purity claim is established by this theorem.

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.WKBConnection.decoherence_nonneg

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.WKBConnection.noise_floor_nonneg
apex_theorems.claims: For ExactWKBParams with Gamma_H>=0 and kappa>0, noiseFloor p:=decoherenceParam p/2 is nonnegative. This is an algebraic property of the defined floor, independent of the Bogoliubov coefficients; physical FDR applicability remains the manuscript's stated external assumption.

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.WKBConnection.noise_floor_eq_delta_diss
apex_theorems.claims: The identity noiseFloor p=Gamma_H/kappa follows by unfolding noiseFloor:=decoherenceParam/2 and decoherenceParam:=2*Gamma_H/kappa. Its physical interpretation as a mandatory noise floor is conditional on the separately supplied fluctuation-dissipation relation.

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.WKBConnection.occupation_reduces_to_beta_sq
apex_theorems.claims: Zero-damping specialization: for ExactWKBParams p, ModifiedBogoliubov p b and Gamma_H=0, totalOccupation p b=beta_sq. At finite damping the defined total is beta_sq/(1-decoherenceParam p)+noiseFloor p; the theorem does not assert beta_sq+noiseFloor at finite damping.

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.WKBConnection.noise_dominates_when_beta_small
apex_theorems.claims: Conditional dominance: for ExactWKBParams p and ModifiedBogoliubov p b, assume decoherenceParam p<1 and beta_sq<noiseFloor p*(1-decoherenceParam p). Then the defined hawkingOccupation p b is less than noiseFloor p. The theorem contains no frequency variable, exponential spectrum or crossover-frequency derivation.

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.GrapheneNoiseFormula.fdt_consistency
apex_theorems.claims: Definitional unit-greybody identity: for real hbar_omega, sigma_Q and n_H, hawkingNoisePSD hbar_omega sigma_Q 1 n_H=2*hbar_omega*sigma_Q*n_H. The source proof unfolds the PSD and uses ring. This theorem evaluates one adopted algebraic formula; it does not compare two independently constructed physical derivations.

apex_theorems.name: SKEFTHawking.GrapheneNoiseFormula.snr_independent_of_sigma_Q
apex_theorems.claims: Within the defined Hawking and Johnson-Nyquist PSDs, for sigma_Q1!=0, sigma_Q2!=0 and kB_T!=0, snrPerBin has the same value at the two conductances when all remaining arguments are fixed. This is cancellation of their shared factor; no Lorenz number, thermal conductivity or Wiedemann-Franz comparison occurs in the theorem.
